utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-sixth. Can everyone hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Nearly joined from the car. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You and half the factory, then.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Honestly, ten minutes looking at the same bloke's brake lights.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Still more entertaining than the football last night.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Depends which end you were supporting.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Don't start. I've only just stopped being annoyed about it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You're coming through twice when you get excited. Teams clearly wants us all to suffer.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we get the full match report—what's already finished?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, finished the repair on the Gas Turbine 2 last night.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's complete, not something carrying into this shift?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Complete. Just giving you the handover, no outstanding repair on that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I finished the repair on the old turbine last night.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That was the repair we'd been carrying over?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the one. Finished, not another go at it today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Both repairs closed, then. Anything else from the shift?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Only an observation: saw the pressure on the barrel on three dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, it recovered without anyone changing anything?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. I'm not asking for an investigation off the back of that, just saying what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, useful context. Not a job request.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And the existing blocker hasn't moved: can't get to the Engel until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: There's no agreed window for that at the minute.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. So it's still blocked, I'm not saying I'm getting onto it today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, keeping that as blocked. Nothing new allocated there.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: On the GT1 fuel valve, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Cal. That's the permit to work and isolation you're taking?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, both. I'll take that, straight away.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not a valve replacement being added in there, just to be clear?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, just the permit to work and isolation for the GT1 fuel valve.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Safety critical, understood.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Pricey, you've got that sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep. That's a separate item from what Cal's just said, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, different kit. The two isolation conversations were starting to run together on the audio.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No worries, they're separate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Pricey, can you swap the filter on the line 1 hydraulics this afternoon as well? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't take that as well. I've got the urgent sign-off I've just committed to. The filter needs someone else.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Stores—sorry, stores Jamie, can you take that instead? Swap the filter on the line 1 hydraulics this afternoon. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead of Pricey. This afternoon, and I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—actual filter swap, not just getting the filter out of stores?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Actual swap, yeah. I'll swap the filter on the line 1 hydraulics.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's with stores Jamie now, not Pricey.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olu, can you schedule downtime for the hot bearing with production this morning? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll schedule that with production this morning. Normal priority, got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's arranging the downtime, not saying the bearing work itself is happening this morning?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll schedule downtime for the hot bearing; we're not agreeing the repair timing here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: David Whitfield, can you replace the seals on the main isolation valve this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I'll replace the seals on the main isolation valve this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And that's the main isolation valve, not the GT1 fuel valve from earlier?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Correct. Separate valve, separate job. Easy enough to lose track when we're all talking at once.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll grease and check the bearings on the old turbine by 11am. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, and that's separate from the repair I finished last night. Just so it doesn't sound like that repair's still open.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. Repair's done. I'm only taking the grease and bearing check, by 11am, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Got you, Sarah. Two different things.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Stores Jamie, can you order spare parts for the Site Water System tomorrow morning, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll order spare parts for the Site Water System tomorrow morning. Spare-minute job, understood.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Ordering only, yeah? Not fitting anything being slipped into that?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ordering only. That's all we're agreeing there.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: While we're on mine, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team next week. That's an 'if you've got a spare minute' one, not something to bump the other work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. Organise the toolbox talk for the team next week, spare-minute priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep. And I mean organise it, not that we're holding the talk on this call.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, because the football analysis was already quite a long toolbox talk.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: With absolutely no useful learning points.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Plenty. Mainly about disappointment.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, lovely. Everything agreed, and the blocked item stays blocked. No mystery jobs hidden in the handover.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, everyone.
